As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins. 
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

■Explore the World on a Planetary Scale
Soar the skies with your airship—the Highwind—and explore a vast, interconnected world. Choose where to drop and skydive down to areas of interest across a wide variety of biomes, cities, and remote frontiers.

■An Iconic Ensemble, Fully United
Fight alongside a roster of unique companions, including newly playable party members Cid Highwind and Vincent Valentine. Each character brings distinct combat roles and abilities to the fray, greatly expanding your strategic options.

■Refined Action and Strategy
Experience the series’ iconic hybrid of real‑time action and command‑based combat in its most polished form yet. Seamlessly switch between party members, issue commands in Tactical Mode, and unleash powerful abilities and synergies to overcome colossal threats.

■Deep Customization and Builds
Prepare your team for the battles ahead with extensive customization options. Adjust your characters' weapons, armor, skills, materia, and FITS—a new system which adds class-based abilities and special outfits. Refine your builds to suit your playstyle and adapt to each unique encounter.

Pre-order Fable now to receive the Pre-Order Content Pack, featuring the questionably heroic Chicken Suit and a collection of charming in-game Gifts: a Wild Flower Bouquet, a Toy Chicken, and a Scones & Jam Picnic Hamper. Use them to build your reputation and shape how Albion sees your Hero.*

Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

A NEW BEGINNING FOR A LEGENDARY FRANCHISE
Fable returns in a stunning reboot of a beloved franchise. As the first Hero in a generation, explore a living Albion filled with peculiar characters, dark humour, and chickens... lots of chickens. This isn’t just nostalgia — it’s a new beginning set in a beautifully vibrant open world.
 
BE THE HERO YOU WANT TO BE
Customize your Hero’s appearance and wield powerful weapons as you weave melee, ranged, and magical combat. Take on bandits, beasts, and creatures — including brand-new enemies and fan-favorites like Hobbes, Balverines, and Trolls. Your power grows right alongside your reputation.

BUILD AN EXTRAORDINARY LIFE
Beyond all the combat lies a living world where you can carve your own identity. Get filthy rich as a landlord or blacksmith, romance a villager (or three), have a bunch of kids, and watch as your reputation precedes you. Being a Hero is a bit like being a celebrity… if celebrities carried swords and occasionally battled giant fire-breathing chickens.

YOUR CHOICES CHANGE THE WORLD
In Albion, a Hero’s reputation is everything. Your noble deeds and questionable decisions affect your relationship with each villager and can even shape the world around you. Whose opinion matters most? The choice is yours… and so are the consequences. It’s up to you to decide what it means to be a Hero.

Fairytale Ending Not Guaranteed.

In this thrilling, nightmare-infused adventure, you as a puppet will harness the power of string & control bar to create an engaging combat system. With an arsenal of tools and abilities designed to decimate your enemies, manipulate their action, and solve complex puzzles.

Combo system 
Take your puppeteer style combat to the next level with a fluid combo system that lets you mix and match your attacks with style. Choose from three unique control bars, each offering a different combat style to combine light but swift attack, long reaching medium attack, and bashing strike from heavy attacks into devastating combo sequences for the enemies.

Collision Combat
Smash, crash, and slam your way through enemies and obstacles with satisfying, high-impact collisions. Customize your playstyle to take down the twisted nightmare to rescue your friend.

Wrap and Tie
Dominate the enemies with your “puppet string”, wrap around them to pull them all into devastating crashes. Stunning them, and breaking objects as you solve puzzles and clear the path forward.

Leap
Conquer the nightmare realm's irregular terrain with your trusty string and control bar. Leap over vast gaps, hop between moving platforms, and evade deadly attacks as you leap toward the end of your journey.

Slingshot
Charge up your string and launch yourself like a projectile. Carve yourself a new path by crushing a giant boulder in your way, or turn the tide of any fight with precision and speed, send them flying with crushing impacts, interrupt the boss attacks, and gain overwhelming advantage.

Hook
Turn the environment into your ally by hooking. Pull foes into the abyss, or interrupt them to create opportunities for the perfect strike, control the battlefield with your creativity. Use the new hook and pull the ring to open a path forward in your journey

Link
Link your enemies together and take them out in one fell swoop. Deal devastating chain damage by connecting multiple foes and connect an electrical circuit to solve complex puzzles. Use this newfound power to carve through monstrous hordes and puzzle to claim your victory over every obstacle that stands in your way.

productSummaries.description:
EXODUS is a cinematic single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. 

You are Jun Aslan, a salvager fighting for the future of your homeworld. Explore ancient ruins, blast your way past hostile Celestial enemies and rival human factions, and recover powerful Remnants to reshape your civilization. Discover your destiny and lead a crew of unforgettable companions as you search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

Unravel an Epic, Cinematic Story 

•Rise from a survivor of a Rot-infested world into someone capable of shaping the future, as choices of virtue or ambition shape the legacy you leave behind. 
•As heir to the Aslan Dynasty, you must prepare the next generation of Travelers to embark on Exodus to save your world, knowing years will be lost before you return.

Lead Your Crew, Build Your Dynasty

•Assemble a crew of sharp-edged specialists — soldiers, smugglers, mercs, scholars, and Awakened animals — whose skills and chemistry shape every fight and decision. 
•Build bonds with your companions — fight beside them, fall for them, save them, or lose them. 

Explore the Ruins of Forgotten Worlds

•Descend into the wrecks of ancient civilizations, derelict alien ships, and forgotten tombs few have ever laid eyes on. 
•Salvage powerful weapons, lost technology, and artifacts the universe was meant to forget, and humanity was never meant to possess. 

Make Hard Choices with Real Consequences

•Your decisions will affect your crew, your missions, the people who stay behind, and the fate of your entire world. 
•Because of Time Dilation, your actions will echo across generations as you adventure across the distant frontiers of time and space. 

Fight for Humanity’s Future

•Wield the Recycler—a special weapon that, once upgraded and modified, can morph into what you need, when you need it.
•Command the Gauntlet — a one-of-a-kind weapon and tool only you can wield, fusing scavenged alien tech into devastating new abilities. 

Survive a Hostile Galaxy

•Take down monstrous creatures, ancient war machines, rival salvagers, and the universe's apex predators: the Celestials.
•Tear through encounters your way — guns blazing, slipping through unseen, or sometimes talking your way past the trouble.

Play Within a New, Sci-Fi Universe

•Embark on an adventure 40,000 years from Earth, where Time Dilation brings the true cost of interstellar travel to life. 
•Discover a rich universe that has expanded into a tabletop RPG, a novel duology by award-winning author Peter F. Hamilton, and an episode of Amazon Prime’s Secret Level series.

Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed. 

A NEW BEGINNING FOR A LEGENDARY FRANCHISE 
Fable returns in a stunning reboot of a beloved franchise. As the first Hero in a generation, explore a living Albion filled with peculiar characters, dark humour, and chickens... lots of chickens. This isn’t just nostalgia — it’s a new beginning set in a beautifully vibrant open world. 
  
BE THE HERO YOU WANT TO BE 
Customize your Hero’s appearance and wield powerful weapons as you weave melee, ranged, and magical combat. Take on bandits, beasts, and creatures — including brand-new enemies and fan-favorites like Hobbes, Balverines, and Trolls. Your power grows right alongside your reputation. 

BUILD AN EXTRAORDINARY LIFE 
Beyond all the combat lies a living world where you can carve your own identity. Get filthy rich as a landlord or blacksmith, romance a villager (or three), have a bunch of kids, and watch as your reputation precedes you. Being a Hero is a bit like being a celebrity… if celebrities carried swords and occasionally battled giant fire-breathing chickens. 

YOUR CHOICES CHANGE THE WORLD 
In Albion, a Hero’s reputation is everything. Your noble deeds and questionable decisions affect your relationship with each villager and can even shape the world around you. Whose opinion matters most? The choice is yours… and so are the consequences. It’s up to you to decide what it means to be a Hero. 

Fairytale Ending Not Guaranteed.

Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed. 

Customize your Hero’s appearance, master style-weaving combat, and build relationships in a richly detailed open world brimming with eccentric villagers and twisted fairytale creatures. Want to settle down after slaying a troll? Go ahead: buy a cottage, flirt with the neighbors, and run the town shop. Or skip all that and chase chickens. Because why not?  

Every decision affects your story and the fate of Albion itself. Will you be a shining role model or the kind of Hero parents warn their children about? In Fable, the only certainty is that your tale will be unforgettable.

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

■Story
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

■Characters
Choose from eight protagonists, each with a unique story, and recruit over twenty allies to your party

■Graphics
Inspired by the original pixel art and Tomomi Kobayashi's illustrations, the remake features character designs by Yoshiro Ambe and fully realized 3D environments.

■Freeform Scenario System
Your choices shape the adventure, from the stories you pursue to the order in which you challenge the Sinistrals, creating a unique experience every playthrough.

■Battle and Character Power Systems
Classic SaGa features such as Glimmer and Formation return alongside a new timeline-based battle system and United Attacks for deeper tactical combat.

■Difficulty
Choose from Casual, Normal, or Classic difficulty to tailor the challenge to your playstyle.

■Music and Voices
Original composer Kenji Ito supervised newly arranged music, with players able to switch between original and arranged tracks.

From the BAFTA award-winning studio Sumo Digital comes a one-of-a-kind spy adventure!

Set in a retro-futuristic 1970s spy world, you play as Agent 8: the world's tiniest and most adorable robot spider superspy. Built by the British Spy Agency S.A.F.E using experimental technology, Agent 8 was made for top-secret missions. With sticky sucker feet that cling to any surface, this little spy can crawl anywhere — even upside down.

Your mission is to stop the evil organisation S.I.N and save the world. From rescuing astronauts to sabotaging a submarine or stopping a speeding train, every level is packed with tiny spy-sized missions. Use Agent 8’s gadgets to slip past obstacles, explore every corner, and uncover clever surprises. It’s all about problem-solving, stealth, and adventure!

Unleash your Spyder skills and become the ultimate superspy!

Get rich or die trying! You are free to agree with El Presidente – on the greatness of Tropico and his unmatched leadership skills. In Tropico 7, you step into his shiny boots again to build your archipelago nation and – literally – move mountains.

With great power comes great responsibility – and even greater opportunity. As the most benevolent leader of your island nation, guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity. Remember: Control isn’t tyranny, it’s efficiency – and more control means more efficiency (except when Penultimo is involved, but that’s another story).

Exert your control and shape the landscape you are building on to fit your vision. Plan and construct complex city layouts, fulfil the multifaceted needs of your subjects, give precise directions to your army, and look down on your opponents in the council, all while revelling in your own splendour. See how it all leads to ever greater efficiency? This could be an aspiring dictator’s dream come true indeed… however, sometimes life gives you lemons. Or obstacles in the shape of a very clever and very annoying opponent: Victoria Guerra! You will need all your skills, cunning and presidential ‘grandeur’ to end this latest chapter with a simple truth: ¡Victoria no es la revolución!

• Lead your nation to new heights: Tropico 7 tells El Presidente’s continuous success story across 5 campaign maps – starring himself, Penultimo and a new nemesis: Victoria Guerra.

• More is more: Archipelagos, with the biggest islands ever in the series, await your rule, expanded with 10 extra scenarios, more than 20 sandbox maps, and endless possibilities with a random map generator.

• Move mountains – literally: Erase them, create beaches, or even create entirely new islands! The new terraforming feature brings your megalomaniac dreams to life. Start that mammoth project – NOW!

• Bollocks uhm… Politics: Navigate the snares and pits of internal politics, when you summon the different factions to your council, a new way to meet them face to face while you pulverize their dreams – or use them for a BIG DEAL to your own advantage.

• Make the world your playground: Elections, election speeches and a vast portfolio of edicts depending on your political standing spice up your daily rule while you juggle foreign affairs and occasionally steal... uhm relocate a landmark to revel in its benefits.

• Built to prosper: Strategically place buildings to make use of synergy effects, keep citizen satisfaction high, and fill any unused plots of land with beautiful parks in a freely customized size.

• Generalissimo No. 1: Eliminate those pesky rebels and fend off foreign threats with a reworked military system enabling more direct control of your military units.

• Always judge a book by its cover: Customize the appearance of your palace and El Presidente with new and creative options.

Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

A NEW BEGINNING FOR A LEGENDARY FRANCHISE
Fable returns in a stunning reboot of a beloved franchise. As the first Hero in a generation, explore a living Albion filled with peculiar characters, dark humour, and chickens... lots of chickens. This isn’t just nostalgia — it’s a new beginning set in a beautifully vibrant open world.

Whose opinion matters most? The choice is yours… and so are the consequences. It’s up to you to decide what it means to be a Hero.

Fairytale Ending Not Guaranteed.

In this thrilling, nightmare-infused adventure, you as a puppet will harness the power of string & control bar to create an engaging combat system. With an arsenal of tools and abilities designed to decimate your enemies, manipulate their action, and solve complex puzzles.

Combo system 
Take your puppeteer style combat to the next level with a fluid combo system that lets you mix and match your attacks with style. Choose from three unique control bars, each offering a different combat style to combine light but swift attack, long reaching medium attack, and bashing strike from heavy attacks into devastating combo sequences for the enemies.

Collision Combat
Smash, crash, and slam your way through enemies and obstacles with satisfying, high-impact collisions. Customize your playstyle to take down the twisted nightmare to rescue your friend.

Wrap and Tie
Dominate the enemies with your “puppet string”, wrap around them to pull them all into devastating crashes. Stunning them, and breaking objects as you solve puzzles and clear the path forward.

Leap
Conquer the nightmare realm's irregular terrain with your trusty string and control bar. Leap over vast gaps, hop between moving platforms, and evade deadly attacks as you leap toward the end of your journey.

Slingshot
Charge up your string and launch yourself like a projectile. Carve yourself a new path by crushing a giant boulder in your way, or turn the tide of any fight with precision and speed, send them flying with crushing impacts, interrupt the boss attacks, and gain overwhelming advantage.

Hook
Turn the environment into your ally by hooking. Pull foes into the abyss, or interrupt them to create opportunities for the perfect strike, control the battlefield with your creativity. Use the new hook and pull the ring to open a path forward in your journey

Link
Link your enemies together and take them out in one fell swoop. Deal devastating chain damage by connecting multiple foes and connect an electrical circuit to solve complex puzzles. Use this newfound power to carve through monstrous hordes and puzzle to claim your victory over every obstacle that stands in your way.

EXODUS is a cinematic single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. 

You are Jun Aslan, a salvager fighting for the future of your homeworld. Explore ancient ruins, blast your way past hostile Celestial enemies and rival human factions, and recover powerful Remnants to reshape your civilization. Discover your destiny and lead a crew of unforgettable companions as you search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

Unravel an Epic, Cinematic Story 

•Rise from a survivor of a Rot-infested world into someone capable of shaping the future, as choices of virtue or ambition shape the legacy you leave behind. 
•As heir to the Aslan Dynasty, you must prepare the next generation of Travelers to embark on Exodus to save your world, knowing years will be lost before you return.

Lead Your Crew, Build Your Dynasty

•Assemble a crew of sharp-edged specialists — soldiers, smugglers, mercs, scholars, and Awakened animals — whose skills and chemistry shape every fight and decision. 
•Build bonds with your companions — fight beside them, fall for them, save them, or lose them. 

Explore the Ruins of Forgotten Worlds

•Descend into the wrecks of ancient civilizations, derelict alien ships, and forgotten tombs few have ever laid eyes on. 
•Salvage powerful weapons, lost technology, and artifacts the universe was meant to forget, and humanity was never meant to possess. 

Make Hard Choices with Real Consequences

•Your decisions will affect your crew, your missions, the people who stay behind, and the fate of your entire world. 
•Because of Time Dilation, your actions will echo across generations as you adventure across the distant frontiers of time and space. 

Fight for Humanity’s Future

•Wield the Recycler—a special weapon that, once upgraded and modified, can morph into what you need, when you need it.
•Command the Gauntlet — a one-of-a-kind weapon and tool only you can wield, fusing scavenged alien tech into devastating new abilities. 

Survive a Hostile Galaxy

•Take down monstrous creatures, ancient war machines, rival salvagers, and the universe's apex predators: the Celestials.
•Tear through encounters your way — guns blazing, slipping through unseen, or sometimes talking your way past the trouble.

Play Within a New, Sci-Fi Universe

•Embark on an adventure 40,000 years from Earth, where Time Dilation brings the true cost of interstellar travel to life. 
•Discover a rich universe that has expanded into a tabletop RPG, a novel duology by award-winning author Peter F. Hamilton, and an episode of Amazon Prime’s Secret Level series.

Fable returns in a stunning reboot of a beloved franchise. As the first Hero in a generation, explore a living Albion filled with peculiar characters, dark humour, and chickens... lots of chickens. This isn’t just nostalgia — it’s a new beginning set in a beautifully vibrant open world.
 
BE THE HERO YOU WANT TO BE
Customize your Hero’s appearance and wield powerful weapons as you weave melee, ranged, and magical combat. Take on bandits, beasts, and creatures — including brand-new enemies and fan-favorites like Hobbes, Balverines, and Trolls. Your power grows right alongside your reputation.

BUILD AN EXTRAORDINARY LIFE
Beyond all the combat lies a living world where you can carve your own identity. Get filthy rich as a landlord or blacksmith, romance a villager (or three), have a bunch of kids, and watch as your reputation precedes you. Being a Hero is a bit like being a celebrity… if celebrities carried swords and occasionally battled giant fire-breathing chickens.

YOUR CHOICES CHANGE THE WORLD
In Albion, a Hero’s reputation is everything. Your noble deeds and questionable decisions affect your relationship with each villager and can even shape the world around you. Whose opinion matters most? The choice is yours… and so are the consequences. It’s up to you to decide what it means to be a Hero.

Fairytale Ending Not Guaranteed.

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

■Story
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

■Characters
Choose from eight protagonists, each with a unique story, and recruit over twenty allies to your party

■Graphics
Inspired by the original pixel art and Tomomi Kobayashi's illustrations, the remake features character designs by Yoshiro Ambe and fully realized 3D environments.

■Freeform Scenario System
Your choices shape the adventure, from the stories you pursue to the order in which you challenge the Sinistrals, creating a unique experience every playthrough.

■Battle and Character Power Systems
Classic SaGa features such as Glimmer and Formation return alongside a new timeline-based battle system and United Attacks for deeper tactical combat.

■Difficulty
Choose from Casual, Normal, or Classic difficulty to tailor the challenge to your playstyle.

■Music and Voices
Original composer Kenji Ito supervised newly arranged music, with players able to switch between original and arranged tracks.

From the BAFTA award-winning studio Sumo Digital comes a one-of-a-kind spy adventure!

Set in a retro-futuristic 1970s spy world, you play as Agent 8: the world's tiniest and most adorable robot spider superspy. Built by the British Spy Agency S.A.F.E using experimental technology, Agent 8 was made for top-secret missions. With sticky sucker feet that cling to any surface, this little spy can crawl anywhere — even upside down.

Your mission is to stop the evil organisation S.I.N and save the world. From rescuing astronauts to sabotaging a submarine or stopping a speeding train, every level is packed with tiny spy-sized missions. Use Agent 8’s gadgets to slip past obstacles, explore every corner, and uncover clever surprises. It’s all about problem-solving, stealth, and adventure!

Unleash your Spyder skills and become the ultimate superspy!

Get rich or die trying! You are free to agree with El Presidente – on the greatness of Tropico and his unmatched leadership skills. In Tropico 7, you step into his shiny boots again to build your archipelago nation and – literally – move mountains.

With great power comes great responsibility – and even greater opportunity. As the most benevolent leader of your island nation, guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity. Remember: Control isn’t tyranny, it’s efficiency – and more control means more efficiency (except when Penultimo is involved, but that’s another story).

Exert your control and shape the landscape you are building on to fit your vision. Plan and construct complex city layouts, fulfil the multifaceted needs of your subjects, give precise directions to your army, and look down on your opponents in the council, all while revelling in your own splendour. See how it all leads to ever greater efficiency? This could be an aspiring dictator’s dream come true indeed… however, sometimes life gives you lemons. Or obstacles in the shape of a very clever and very annoying opponent: Victoria Guerra! You will need all your skills, cunning and presidential ‘grandeur’ to end this latest chapter with a simple truth: ¡Victoria no es la revolución!

• Lead your nation to new heights: Tropico 7 tells El Presidente’s continuous success story across 5 campaign maps – starring himself, Penultimo and a new nemesis: Victoria Guerra.

• More is more: Archipelagos, with the biggest islands ever in the series, await your rule, expanded with 10 extra scenarios, more than 20 sandbox maps, and endless possibilities with a random map generator.

• Move mountains – literally: Erase them, create beaches, or even create entirely new islands! The new terraforming feature brings your megalomaniac dreams to life. Start that mammoth project – NOW!

• Bollocks uhm… Politics: Navigate the snares and pits of internal politics, when you summon the different factions to your council, a new way to meet them face to face while you pulverize their dreams – or use them for a BIG DEAL to your own advantage.

• Make the world your playground: Elections, election speeches and a vast portfolio of edicts depending on your political standing spice up your daily rule while you juggle foreign affairs and occasionally steal... uhm relocate a landmark to revel in its benefits.

• Built to prosper: Strategically place buildings to make use of synergy effects, keep citizen satisfaction high, and fill any unused plots of land with beautiful parks in a freely customized size.

• Generalissimo No. 1: Eliminate those pesky rebels and fend off foreign threats with a reworked military system enabling more direct control of your military units.

• Always judge a book by its cover: Customize the appearance of your palace and El Presidente with new and creative options.
